mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_usage (service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd) VALUES (#{service}, #{day}, #{calls}, #{usd}, #{remainingUsd}) ON CONFLICT (service, day) DO UPDATE SET calls = api_usage.calls + EXCLUDED.calls, usd = api_usage.usd + EXCLUDED.usd, remaining_usd = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.remaining_usd, api_usage.remaining_usd)
mapper.select: SELECT service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd FROM api_usage WHERE service = #{service} AND day = #{day}
SELECT service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd FROM api_usage WHERE day = #{day} ORDER BY service
